user.title: Choose a Remote Home-Assistant connection
user.description: Beam uses this Home Assistant directly. Select an existing connection to reuse its remote address, access token and entity prefix.

manual.title: Connect to another Home Assistant
manual.description: On the remote Home Assistant, sign in as an administrator. Open your profile, select Security, then create a token under Long-lived access tokens. Paste it below and enter the remote base URL and optional entity prefix.

local_creation.title: Authorize creation of a local dashboard
local_creation.description: A brand-new dashboard on this instance uses Home Assistant's dashboard creation API. In your local administrator profile, open Security and create a token under Long-lived access tokens. An existing local dashboard or a new view within one does not need this step.

source.title: Choose the first sync source
source.description: Choose which site supplies the first copy. After the first sync, changes can travel both ways.

new_destination.title: Name the new destination
new_destination.description: Enter the name of the new dashboard or view. Beam chooses its URL and creates it during the first valid sync.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read both instances. Check the address, connection and administrator token. If needed, select manual remote access.
error.remote_not_admin: The remote account cannot manage dashboards. Select manual access and use a remote administrator's token.
error.invalid_input: Enter a Home Assistant base URL and a valid entity prefix.
error.empty_destination_name: Enter a name for the new dashboard or view.
error.no_dashboards: Create an editable dashboard on at least one instance first.

abort.overlap: One of these dashboards or views is already managed by another rule.
